title: Global Lifting Sling Market Trend 2026: Rising Demand for Synthetic Fiber Slings
excerpt: The global heavy lifting & material handling industry is undergoing a profound material revolution. Driven by the continuous recovery of infrastructure, wind power, offshore engineering and mining projects worldwide,...
content:

Driven by the continuous recovery of infrastructure, wind power, offshore engineering and mining projects worldwide, the demand for lifting slings, shackles, chains and electric handling equipment keeps a steady growth trend. Market research shows the global market for polyester and HMPE high-performance synthetic fiber lifting slings keeps a 5.4% CAGR and is gradually replacing traditional wire rope slings in more scenarios.

Compared with wire rope, synthetic fiber slings feature light weight, burr-free surface and excellent acid & alkali resistance, ideal for offshore engineering, chemical plants and precision equipment lifting. They also have visual wear indicators and fully comply with ISO, EN and ASME international safety standards. For overseas buyers, product traceability, CE certification and third-party load test reports have become mandatory procurement thresholds. Meanwhile, global safety regulations are continuously tightening. The updated EN 1492 European standard and US OSHA lifting regulations require periodic inspection and complete inspection records for all rigging hardware. This pushes global contractors to shift from unit price priority to full-lifecycle safety cost assessment.

title: Practical Safety Control for Lifting Operations & International Standard Interpretation
excerpt: Most lifting accidents stem from non-standard on-site operations. According to international safety statistics, over 35% of lifting incidents are caused by improper sling selection, incorrect lifting point positioning...
content:
Most lifting accidents stem from non-standard on-site operations. According to international safety statistics, over 35% of lifting incidents are caused by improper sling selection, incorrect lifting point positioning and unreasonable sling angles. Whether in construction sites, factory equipment relocation or port heavy cargo handling, standardized lifting management processes are the core of risk prevention.

A complete compliant lifting workflow includes: pre-lifting load calculation, gravity center confirmation, visual sling inspection, trial lift test, site exclusion zone setup, and dedicated signalman command. Before each operation, the WLL (Working Load Limit) of all rigging must be verified, and overloading is strictly prohibited. The sling angle should be controlled at about 60°, with minimum not lower than 45°; an excessively small angle multiplies the actual tension and causes breakage risk.

Sharp edges on workpieces must be fitted with corner guards to prevent cutting slings. No personnel are allowed to stand under suspended loads, and high-altitude lifting must be stopped in strong wind conditions. On many overseas projects, site supervisors verify operator qualifications and sling inspection certificates before work starts.

JIN YANG HU has sorted out complete lifting safety operation specifications based on international common standards. All rigging products are marked with clear WLL and angle warning signs, and we provide supporting safety training materials and load calculation tools to help customers standardize on-site operations and reduce accident risks.

title: Overseas Buying Guide for Heavy Material Handling Equipment: Certification, Load Test & Supply Chain Risk

However, many buyers encounter problems such as fake certificates, falsely marked load capacity, delayed delivery and missing after-sales service, resulting in project shutdown losses.

When purchasing heavy lifting equipment, these core documents must be verified: CE certification for EU market, OSHA compliance for US market, destructive load test report, material certificate and permanent nameplate marking. For safety components like slings, shackles and hooks, low-cost white-label products without test reports are not recommended.

Products should be matched with working conditions: G80 high-strength chain slings for high-temperature metallurgy; galvanized or stainless steel hardware for humid and seawater environments; flexible synthetic slings for painted precision workpieces. From the supply chain perspective, priority should be given to original manufacturers with in-house testing laboratories.

title: Wire Rope Sling Periodic Inspection & Scrap Criteria per ISO 4309 Standard
excerpt: Wire rope slings are the most widely used products in heavy lifting, but many on-site operators ignore scrap standards and keep using damaged slings, creating major safety hazards. According to ISO 4309 wire rope...
content:
Wire rope slings are the most widely used products in heavy lifting, but many on-site operators ignore scrap standards and keep using damaged slings, creating major safety hazards. According to ISO 4309 wire rope inspection standard, visual inspection before each use and periodic in-depth inspection are mandatory.

Core scrap indicators include: excessive broken wires, wear or corrosion exceeding 10% of the original diameter, kinks, severe flattening, internal corrosion and heat burn marks. Once any defect occurs, the sling must be stopped immediately and scrapped. Repair and continued use after welding are strictly prohibited.

Inspection frequency varies with working conditions. For slings used in frequent cyclic lifting or corrosive environments, the inspection cycle needs to be shortened. All inspection records must be documented in writing, and supervisors of large overseas projects will regularly audit inspection files.

JIN YANG HU wire rope slings are made of high-strength galvanized steel wire, with pre-stretching and load testing before delivery. Each product is attached with a detailed inspection guide manual, and we can provide regular inspection services to help customers establish complete equipment management files.

title: Risk Prevention & Equipment Selection for Lifting Work under Low-Temperature Conditions
excerpt: Low temperature in high-latitude winter will significantly change the mechanical properties of metal and synthetic materials. Steel becomes more brittle and prone to fracture in cold environments; some synthetic fiber...
content:
Low temperature in high-latitude winter will significantly change the mechanical properties of metal and synthetic materials. Steel becomes more brittle and prone to fracture in cold environments; some synthetic fiber slings lose toughness at sub-zero temperatures, reducing the safety margin of lifting operations.

For lifting operations in freezing environments, first evaluate the low-temperature impact performance of sling, hook and shackle materials, and give priority to low-temperature quenched alloy steel hardware. Pre-heating inspection of equipment should be carried out before lifting, focusing on crack detection. Lifting operations should be slowed down to avoid shock loads.

In terms of operation scheme, sudden start and drop should be reduced to prevent impact damage to slings. For storage, rigging accessories should be stored indoors to keep warm and avoid long-term outdoor ice and snow corrosion.

JIN YANG HU provides a special low-temperature lifting series, including low-temperature alloy steel rigging and cold-resistant synthetic slings. All products have passed -40°C low-temperature impact tests and are suitable for cold-climate projects in Northern Europe, Canada and Russia.

title: Common Violations & Accident Warning for Aerial Work Platform Operation

title: Electric Flat Trolley Abnormal Running Noise: Troubleshooting & Complete Repair Guide
excerpt: Heavy-duty electric flat transport trolleys widely used in factories and warehouses often develop abnormal running noise after long-term service. Common noise sources are divided into four categories: worn wheel...
content:
Heavy-duty electric flat transport trolleys widely used in factories and warehouses often develop abnormal running noise after long-term service. Common noise sources are divided into four categories: worn wheel assemblies, rusted bearings, loose frame bolts, deteriorated reduction gear oil and motor bearing failure.

Systematic troubleshooting steps: First, run the trolley at low speed with no load to distinguish whether the noise comes from wheels or gearbox; Second, lift the trolley and rotate the wheels manually to check bearing clearance and rubber wheel cracking; Third, check all vehicle connecting fasteners for looseness.

If the wheel assembly is worn, replace it with the same specification load wheel directly; rusted bearings need disassembly, replacement and grease refilling; gearbox noise requires gear oil inspection, and severe wear needs gear mechanism overhaul. Daily maintenance includes regular bolt tightening, wheel debris cleaning and lubrication replacement to reduce failure probability.

JIN YANG HU electric flat trolleys adopt high-precision silent bearings and thickened wear-resistant wheel surfaces, with modular design for easy disassembly and replacement. We also provide matching wearing parts kits to reduce on-site maintenance difficulty.

title: Wear Protection & Service Life Extension Tips for Synthetic Web Lifting Slings
excerpt: Polyester synthetic web slings are lightweight and do not damage the paint surface of workpieces, and are widely used in equipment lifting and stainless steel workpiece handling. Sharp edge cutting, excessive friction...
content:
Polyester synthetic web slings are lightweight and do not damage the paint surface of workpieces, and are widely used in equipment lifting and stainless steel workpiece handling. Sharp edge cutting, excessive friction and chemical corrosion are the main causes of sling damage.

Correct operation points: Install corner guards or soft pads on all sharp edges of workpieces before lifting, and it is forbidden for slings to be directly stuck on sharp metal edges; avoid dragging slings on the ground or steel structure surfaces; the storage environment should be dry and shaded, away from strong acid and alkali solvents, and long-term sun exposure is not allowed.

Daily inspection focuses on outer fabric wear, cuts, burn marks and softening discoloration. Once internal fiber exposure or deep cuts appear, the sling must be scrapped immediately and cannot be used continuously.

JIN YANG HU lifting slings adopt double-layer wear-resistant sheath design with built-in wear indicator core, and are equipped with special corner guards and protective sleeves. Reasonable protection can extend the service life of slings by more than 3 times and greatly reduce procurement costs.

title: Hand Chain Hoist Chain Jamming: Root Causes, Inspection Steps & Solutions
excerpt: Manual chain hoists are the most commonly used manual lifting tools in workshops. Stuck chain and hard pulling are frequent faults. Common triggers include: twisted and deformed chain links, sand and rust stuck in the...
content:
Manual chain hoists are the most commonly used manual lifting tools in workshops. Stuck chain and hard pulling are frequent faults. Common triggers include: twisted and deformed chain links, sand and rust stuck in the chain sprocket, insufficient internal lubrication, worn brake pawls and chain misalignment.

Troubleshooting operation: First remove the load and test the hoist without load; clean rust and dirt from the chain and apply special lubricating grease; check whether the lifting chain is twisted and deformed — deformed chains are forbidden to continue using; check brake pad wear condition.

It is forbidden to pull the chain with brute force, which may cause chain breakage and heavy load falling. For maintenance, clean the chain after each use, store it in a dry environment, and lubricate regularly.

JIN YANG HU manual chain hoists adopt high-precision heat-treated chains with guide wheel design, which greatly reduces the probability of chain jamming. Each product is equipped with special lubricating grease and maintenance tools for daily maintenance.

title: Assembly Flood Barrier Installation & Sealing Construction Technical Points
excerpt: Modular flood barriers are widely used in flood protection for underground parking lots, factory gates and power distribution rooms. The sealing effect of the barrier depends on profile flatness, rubber sealing strip...
content:
Modular flood barriers are widely used in flood protection for underground parking lots, factory gates and power distribution rooms. The sealing effect of the barrier depends on profile flatness, rubber sealing strip installation, foundation embedded parts and joint gap treatment.

Before construction, measure the flatness of the ground foundation, and level the ground if the height difference is too large; the sealing strip should be completely embedded into the clamping groove, and clean the sand and debris on the contact surface before installation; reserve reasonable compression amount at the splicing position, and tighten the bolts evenly to avoid water leakage gaps caused by one-side compression.

After installation, water tightness test is recommended to check water seepage at splicing joints and bottom positions. For daily storage, protect rubber seals to avoid aging and cracking.

JIN YANG HU flood barriers adopt 6063-T5 aluminum alloy profiles and EPDM rubber sealing strips, with modular design for quick installation. The sealing performance reaches IP67 level, and we can provide on-site installation technical guidance.

title: On-site Quick Inspection Specification for Lifting Hook Crack Detection
excerpt: Lifting hooks are the core safety components of hoisting systems, and metal fatigue cracks are a major safety hazard. In addition to professional magnetic particle inspection, on-site management personnel can perform...
content:
Lifting hooks are the core safety components of hoisting systems, and metal fatigue cracks are a major safety hazard. In addition to professional magnetic particle inspection, on-site management personnel can perform visual and magnifier simple screening.

Before each use, focus on inspecting the stress bending area, hook shoulder and thread root of the hook, checking for surface cracks, plastic deformation and wear. Once cracks, enlarged opening or twisting deformation appear, scrap immediately. Welding repair on damaged hooks is strictly prohibited.

For regular professional inspection, magnetic particle testing is recommended. This article clarifies hook scrap standards, inspection cycles and safety precautions to help on-site personnel quickly identify risks.

JIN YANG HU lifting hooks are forged from high-quality alloy steel, with 100% magnetic particle inspection before delivery. They are designed with safety latch devices and permanently marked with rated load for convenient on-site inspection.

title: Battery Maintenance, Charging Rules & Life Extension for Electric Material Trolleys
excerpt: The battery is the core component of electric flat trolleys. Improper charging and discharging is the primary cause of premature battery degradation. Charge in a ventilated environment and avoid charging at high...
content:
The battery is the core component of electric flat trolleys. Improper charging and discharging is the primary cause of premature battery degradation. Charge in a ventilated environment and avoid charging at high temperature; do not deep discharge, recharge when the remaining power is about 20%; do not leave the battery fully charged for a long time.

Daily maintenance: Keep battery terminals clean and tight to prevent oxidation and overheating; check the battery case for bulging or leakage; warm up the battery before charging in cold winter. For long-term idle vehicles, recharge once a month.

Different battery types have different maintenance methods. Lead-acid batteries need regular water replenishment and sulfation treatment, while lithium batteries pay more attention to BMS system calibration.

JIN YANG HU electric trolleys can be equipped with high-performance lithium batteries and BMS battery management system, with overcharge and over-discharge protection. The matching smart charger can effectively extend battery cycle life by 30%.

title: Shackle Load Selection Calculation, Assembly & Safety Prohibitions
excerpt: Shackles are critical connecting pieces in rigging systems. Wrong selection can easily trigger lifting accidents. The first principle of selection: the rated working load (WLL) of the shackle must be greater than the...
content:
Shackles are critical connecting pieces in rigging systems. Wrong selection can easily trigger lifting accidents. The first principle of selection: the rated working load (WLL) of the shackle must be greater than the actual working force under working conditions, with sufficient safety margin.

For multi-leg rigging, the load magnification effect caused by sling angles must be calculated. The force on each shackle needs to be converted according to the sling angle, not directly matched by the weight of the heavy object. During installation, the bolt pin must be fully locked, and lateral or side loading of shackles is forbidden.

Safety prohibitions: Do not weld or heat shackles; do not impact, grind or modify shackles; scrap immediately if cracks, obvious deformation or thread damage occur.

JIN YANG HU shackles are forged from high-strength alloy steel with hot-dip galvanized surface. The bolt pins are designed with anti-loosening structure, marked with clear WLL identification. We also provide professional load calculation and selection guidance for customers.

title: Lifting Equipment Motor Overheating: Cause Analysis & Troubleshooting
excerpt: Abnormal overheating of motors on electric hoists and electric trolleys is usually caused by long-time overload operation, damaged cooling fan, unstable voltage, stuck bearing or incompletely released brake. Overheating...
content:
Abnormal overheating of motors on electric hoists and electric trolleys is usually caused by long-time overload operation, damaged cooling fan, unstable voltage, stuck bearing or incompletely released brake.

Overheating will accelerate insulation aging, and in severe cases will directly burn out the motor. Once abnormal temperature rise is found, stop operation immediately for cooling, check whether the load exceeds the standard, and inspect brake clearance, bearing resistance and power supply voltage.

For daily operation and maintenance, keep the motor shell clean and the ventilation port unblocked, and remove dust regularly. The normal temperature rise of the motor is within 60K, and if it exceeds 80K, it is necessary to stop for inspection.

JIN YANG HU lifting motors adopt Class F insulation, with built-in overheating protection device and optimized heat dissipation design, suitable for long-time heavy load work. We also provide complete motor maintenance manuals for customers.
